utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive's at the community center on Oak Street this weekend? I hope it wraps up quick—I've got errands to run.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Wait, Bo, I thought it was at my place first—we're meeting at 10, then heading to Mrs. Chen's fence. Don't forget your toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, right—your place at 10, then the fence. Got it, toolbox and all.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Faye, quick update—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, thanks Rosa! Sunday works better anyway—less rush with school pickup. I'll adjust my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, glad that works for you! Could you help spread the word to the others on the block?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes, the repair drive! I think I've got an old toaster that's been gathering dust. What day is it again?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It's this Saturday, from 10 to 4 at the community center. I've got my tools ready to go too!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, right, Saturday! I should write that down somewhere... maybe I'll just remember it this time. Do you think they can fix a toaster that only toasts on one side?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah! You should join the repair drive this weekend, it's a great chance to meet everyone and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, this weekend! I keep losing track. So we're just fixing that old swing set, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Exactly! And I heard Hana's getting folks to pitch in on bikes and appliances too, so it's turning into a whole neighborhood jam.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday's almost here—are you still set to join me at the repair drive around noon?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I'll be there! Need me to pick up anything on the way?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No, I think we're all set—just bring yourself and any broken items you'd like to fix.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're getting folks together to fix up the playground and more—want to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm in. Got tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, glad to have you on board! I'll add you to the list—bring whatever you've got, we'll put it all to use.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good to me. I can bring my hammer and some spare nails.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would be great, Dane. I've got a broken fence panel that's been needing attention.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Well, if we're tackling yours too, I might need to grab my saw as well.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Nell! Did you catch wind of that repair drive this Saturday? I'm rounding up folks to help fix up the playground—want to join?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, Tess! I've heard a little about it—what exactly are we fixing up?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, the swing set needs new chains and the benches could use a sand-down and fresh paint. Oh, and I think Oren's bringing in a broken toaster too!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: You're Gus, right? Heard you're helping organize the repair drive—still on for next Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, still on! I've got Ira helping with the big pickups and Uli grabbing the small parts, so we're in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to hear. How many volunteers have you actually signed up so far? I need to know before I start calling people.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, I thought we were collecting donations, not fixing fences. Did the plan change?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I see, so the playground equipment—Eli, are we still on the same page there, or did something else get added?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hana, the playground equipment is still on my list for next Tuesday at 9 sharp. Nothing's changed there, but this fence business is throwing me off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Cleo, mind if I take a look at that toolbox before Saturday? I might have a few things to add.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, Rey! Come by whenever. I'll have it out on the porch this afternoon if you want to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. I'll stop by this afternoon then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Kira, do you know if the repair drive is still at the community center on Oak Street?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The repair drive? You mean the one for the community center on Oak? I thought that was just talk—are you sure it's actually happening?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it's confirmed. I checked the official bulletin this morning — it's at the community center on Oak Street, and I've already marked it on my map.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive? I'm still figuring out if I'm going, but Mina was asking about it too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this Saturday at the community center from 9 to 5. They're fixing bikes, appliances, furniture—tell Mina to bring anything!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik. I'll let Mina know—she's got an old toaster she's been meaning to fix.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, Oak Street this weekend — should wrap up by noon, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Bo. I'll be there with my tools. Should be done by noon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, see you then. I'll bring some coffee.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so you're actually helping with that community center repair drive? I thought that was just talk.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think there's something about fixing up the playground equipment—the broken swing, you know? But I'm not sure about the community center part...

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Huh, so you're saying it's just the playground equipment? Are you sure there's no community center work happening?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just don't see how we can manage the whole list with only five people.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Well, if we coordinate the drop-off points, maybe we can streamline the whole thing. I already have a map of the best spots marked out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope you're right, but what about the heavy lifting? My back can't handle that, and I don't see any strong arms among our five.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Sam, heard you're helping with the repair drive too — got any leads on where we can pick up more donations?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got plenty of tools in my shed, but you might check with the hardware store on Elm Street—they sometimes donate leftover supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great tip, Sam—I'll swing by the hardware store today. Do you know anyone there I should ask for?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: So Rosa, what kind of items are people bringing in for the repair drive? I want to make sure my toolbox has the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Cleo! I'm glad you asked. Just a heads-up—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday. As for tools, folks are bringing in small appliances, electronics, and furniture to fix.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sunday at the community center, got it! My toolbox should cover the basics—let me know if there's anything else folks need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Quinn, could you tell me what exactly we're planning to fix in the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before we get started.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Hana, we're fixing pretty much anything broken—small appliances, furniture, electronics, even some tools and clothes! Everyone's bringing their skills and gear, and Cleo's already roped in with her toolbox, so it should be a real community fix-up event.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds like a great, broad effort—so we're not just focused on one thing like the playground, but open to whatever neighbors bring in?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Gus! I heard folks are bringing in hammers and paintbrushes for the playground repairs—did you get a look at that list?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, I've got the list right here—looks like we're covered on hammers, but we could use a few more sturdy paintbrushes for the benches.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to know we're set on hammers—I've got an old paintbrush or two I can toss in. Where should I drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli! So glad you're here—Vik was just telling me about the repair drive, and I thought you'd want in on the action too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I'm a bit confused—Vik said we're fixing a fence, but Tess mentioned collecting donations. Can we sort out the plan?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I think there might be some mix-up—the repair drive is about fixing up old bikes, appliances, and furniture, not just a fence. Want to come check it out?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Leo, have you heard about the repair drive they're organizing this Saturday? I heard they need volunteers and old appliances.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'm organizing it. We need working appliances, not old ones.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I must've gotten that mixed up! Well, I've got a working blender I could donate, and I'm still happy to help out with the playground equipment.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Oren, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? I need to check the school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, yes, the repair drive! I think I vaguely remember talking about that. What did we need to fix again?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We were going to fix up the old playground equipment at the park, remember? It's this Saturday at 10 AM, but I might need to step away for school pickup around 2.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina! Are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So it's definitely this Saturday? I was worried the date might've changed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it's still this Saturday from 10 to 4. I'll be there, so you can find me at the repair station.
